newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-REGGIANA TO PLAY IN BOLOGNA AFTER VIOLENCE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-REGGIANA TO PLAY IN BOLOGNA AFTER VIOLENCE.

text.p: Reggiana's next home Italian serie A match against Piacenza on Sunday will be played in Bologna instead of Reggio Emilia after crowd trouble last month.

The soccer league banned struggling Reggiana from their own ground for one match after fans threw four kilos of metal, including a bathroom tap, at the Parma goal during their local derby match in Reggio on February 16.
The league said Sunday's match would be played at Bologna's Dall'Ara stadium. Bologna are playing at Fiorentina.
